paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the attention weights associated with different explanation lengths. The horizontal axis represents the explanation length, labeled as "Exp. Length," and is divided into categories ranging from 5 to 35 in increments of 5, although the axis is not explicitly labeled with a title for the categories. The vertical axis is labeled "Attention Weights" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.45 in increments of 0.05. There are six blue bars, each representing a different explanation length: 5-10, 10-15, 15-20, 20-25, 25-30, and 30-35. The bars have the following approximate attention weights: 0.38, 0.42, 0.35, 0.31, and 0.35, from left to right, with the tallest bar at 0.42 (for the 10-15 range) and the shortest at 0.31 (for the 20-25 range). The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than by their category label on the horizontal axis, and none of the bars are visually emphasized.
